description: On Friday, the non-partisan National Border Patrol Council (NBPC) endorsed Michael Whatley for US Senate due to his commitment to border security and the men and women who patrol our US borders every day. NBPC President Paul Perez made the endorsement announcement at a series of events across North Carolina.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Accepts Endorsement of National Border Patrol Council – Michael Whatley for Senate
